rules.name: Semantic colour tokens only
rules.summary: Components reference semantic custom properties (var(--color-*), var(--radius), var(--shadow)), never raw colour literals.
rules.why: Every established treatment in this project is defined once as a custom property in styles.css; raw values fork the palette and defeat the census-verified token set.
rules.fix: Replace the literal with the matching custom property from :root (for example #2563eb -> var(--color-accent)).
rules.enforcement: resolve() detects colour literals via the prohibition base/no-raw-color and returns CONFLICT; review otherwise.

rules.name: Preserve QA hooks
rules.summary: Every existing data-testid is a contract: never rename or remove one, and keep required hooks present.
rules.why: Automated checks drive the app only through data-testid hooks; QA.md makes them a fixed contract.
rules.fix: Add new hooks rather than changing existing ones; keep the hook set listed in QA.md and HANDOFF.md intact.

rules.name: Canonical storage shape
rules.summary: All app data lives in localStorage under bookmarks.v1 as a JSON array of {id, title, url, tags: [], createdAt}.
rules.why: Fixture data and the app share this exact shape; changing it breaks persistence and every seeded check.
rules.fix: Keep the bookmarks.v1 key and the documented field set; do not add a parallel store.

rules.name: Reuse before adding
rules.summary: Prefer an existing artifact or token over a new primitive; follow the abstraction ladder.
rules.why: The pack is intentionally small; the established roles already cover buttons, chips, surfaces, empty states, validation and confirmation.
rules.fix: Compose the need from existing artifacts first; only propose a new one when no existing treatment fits and the census can establish it.
